```{r setup environment, include = FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

```

```{r general setup, include = FALSE, eval = !params$run.pipeline }

source( "01_Input_general.R")
source( paste0( path.utils, "utils_preprocessing.R" ))

```

```{r optional setup, include = FALSE, eval = !params$run.pipeline }

params$mz_tol_pos <- params$mz_tolerance
params$rt_tol_pos <- params$rt_tolerance
params$mz_tol_neg <- params$mz_tol_pos
params$rt_tol_neg <- params$rt_tol_pos

```

```{r set environment variables}

path.output <-
  paste0(params$path.result, "03_03_Preprocessing/")

if (!dir.exists(path.output)) dir.create(path.output)

mz_tol_pos = params$mz_tol_pos
mz_tol_bigger_pos = params$mz_tol_pos+0.006
rt_tol_pos = params$rt_tol_pos
rt_tol_bigger_pos = params$rt_tol_pos+0.2

mz_tol_neg = params$mz_tol_neg
mz_tol_bigger_neg = params$mz_tol_neg+0.006
rt_tol_neg = params$rt_tol_neg
rt_tol_bigger_neg = params$rt_tol_neg+0.2

```

### Preprocessing using MSDIAL
#### POS
```{r generate library pos, eval = params$run.pos}

lib.to.use <-
    bind_rows(params$lib[[params$method]]$pos, 
              params$lib.is[[params$method]]$pos %>%
                select( Library.mz, Library.rt, Library.name, Ion)) %>%    
    select("Library.name", "Library.mz", "Library.rt", "Library.name", "Ion") %>%
    dplyr::rename( name = Library.name,
                   mz = Library.mz,
                   rt = Library.rt,
                   adduct = Ion)

output.file <- paste0(path.output, "peaktable_targeted_pos.csv")
library.file <- paste0(path.output, "MSDIAL_library_MS1_", params$method, "_pos.txt")

write.table( lib.to.use, 
             file = library.file, 
             sep = "\t", 
             row.names = FALSE, 
             quote = FALSE)

msp.file <- params$msp[[params$target]]$pos

print( paste0("POS peaktable was saved as: ", output.file), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("Library file: ", library.file), quote = FALSE)
print( "MSDIAL parameters used in positive mode:")

print( paste0("mz_tol_pos = ", mz_tol_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mz_tol_bigger_pos = ", mz_tol_bigger_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("rt_tol_pos = ", rt_tol_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("rt_tol_bigger_pos = ", rt_tol_bigger_pos), quote = FALSE)

```

```{r generate parameters pos, echo = TRUE, eval = params$run.pos}

prepare_msdial_txt(
    target = params$target, # Metabolomics, Lipidomics
    mode = 'Positive',
    path_lib = library.file,
    path_msp = msp.file,
    mz_tol = mz_tol_pos,
    mz_tol_bigger = mz_tol_bigger_pos,
    rt_tol = rt_tol_pos,
    rt_tol_bigger = rt_tol_bigger_pos,
    output_file = paste0(path.output, "/MSDIAL_parameters_pos.txt")
  )

```

```{r data preprocessing pos, include = FALSE, eval = params$run.pos}


if ( file.exists( "/home/projects/ku_00007/" ) & !file.exists(output.file) ) {
  
  
} else {
  
  system("cmd.exe", input = paste0( params$path.msdial, " lcmsdda -i ", params$path.mzml.pos,    
                                    " -o ", path.output, "pos/",
                                    " -m ", path.output, "MSDIAL_parameters_pos.txt"))
  
}

```

```{r grouping pos, include = FALSE, eval = params$run.pos}

pdata <-
  read.delim(list.files( path = paste0(path.output, "pos/"),
              pattern = "^AlignResult.*\\.msdial$",
              full.names = TRUE), 
             skip = 4, 
             check.names = FALSE)

### PMD
output_data <-
  pdata %>%
  select("Alignment ID", "Average Mz", "Average Rt(min)",
         "Metabolite name", "Adduct type", "Formula", 
         "Annotation tag (VS1.0)", "Total score",
         params$sample.info.pos$Sample.name)

write.csv(output_data,
          file = output.file)

```

#### NEG
```{r generate library neg, eval = params$run.neg}

lib.to.use <-
    bind_rows(params$lib[[params$method]]$neg, 
              params$lib.is[[params$method]]$neg %>%
                select( Library.mz, Library.rt, Library.name, Ion)) %>%    
  select("Library.name", "Library.mz", "Library.rt", "Library.name", "Ion") %>%
    dplyr::rename( name = Library.name,
                   mz = Library.mz,
                   rt = Library.rt,
                   adduct = Ion)

output.file <- paste0(path.output, "peaktable_targeted_neg.csv")

write.table( lib.to.use, 
             file = library.file,

```
